svg.title: TSFM PatchTransformer V1 architecture
svg.desc: A univariate history is normalized and cut into 32-step patches (values plus observation mask), embedded to 192 dimensions, passed through 8 bidirectional pre-norm Transformer blocks, and the last patch token is decoded into 192 future steps times 9 quantiles.
svg.text: 6.6M parameters · trained on synthetic data only · zero-shot forecaster

g.text: h > 192: median fed back as history, run again

svg.text: Quantile head on the last patch token
Inference: forecast x and −x in one batch, then qτ = ½ · (qτ(x) − q1−τ(−x)). Trained with the pinball loss on 9 quantiles, 0.1 … 0.9.
